family.name: PINNeAPPle Anchor
family.promise: One named model per engineering problem, published with the error it was measured at, the range it holds in and the checks it passed -- so the answer arrives with the condition under which it is true.

anchors.name: Anchor-Aero
anchors.problem: Lift, drag and pitching moment of a 2-D section from its shape and angle of attack
anchors.replaces: A RANS sweep per design point (meshing + solve) during shape exploration, at Re 4e6, attached to mildly separated flow

members.task: Airfoil aerodynamic coefficients (Cl, Cd, Cm) from shape and angle of attack, 2-D steady RANS

validity_range.geometry_family: 2nd-order Bernstein CST, upper = M + T, lower = M - T, trailing-edge thickness 0.25 % chord
validity_range.regime: fully turbulent (k-omega SST), attached to mildly separated; deep stall (Cl swing > 0.1 over the last 500 iterations) was excluded from training

limitations: Drag at high lift reads ~14 % high on the campaign grid (20k cells) compared with finer grids/XFOIL; the surrogate inherits the solver's bias, it does not correct it.
Not valid in deep stall, at other Reynolds numbers, compressible flow or outside the CST bounds.
Accuracy is against the same solver and grid that generated the training data (interpolation error); the solver's own error against experiment is the larger term.
members.citation: PINNeAPPle contributors (2026). Airfoil RANS campaign (OpenFOAM v1912 simpleFoam, k-omega SST, Re 4e6, 436 runs) and MLP-ensemble surrogate. PINNeAPPle model zoo, https://github.com/PINNeAPPle-Labs/PINNeAPPle

anchors.name: Anchor-Contact
anchors.problem: Wheel-soil contact forces of a rigid grousered wheel on lunar regolith simulant
anchors.replaces: A discrete-element wheel-soil simulation per slip and load condition during mobility studies

members.task: Wheel-soil contact forces of a rigid grousered wheel on lunar regolith simulant (terramechanics)

validity_range.wheel: VIPER wheel, R 0.25 m, b 0.20 m, 24 grousers
validity_range.physics: Wong-Reece with slip-sinkage n = n0 + n1 s on driving slip (GRC-1: n0 0.8, n1 0.8); steady state, so the slip that sets the exponent equals the slip

limitations: Only as good as the Wong-Reece model: against published single-wheel tests the model's drawbar pull RMSE is 4-14 N (digitised data), larger than the surrogate's own error.
One soil and one wheel; zero slip angle (no lateral force); steady state.
Slip-sinkage makes the forces kink at zero slip (the exponent grows only with driving slip); the network smooths the kink over a small slip interval.
members.citation: PINNeAPPle contributors (2026). Wheel-soil contact PINN surrogate (Wong-Reece, GRC-1, VIPER wheel). PINNeAPPle model zoo, https://github.com/PINNeAPPle-Labs/PINNeAPPle

anchors.name: Anchor-Thermal-Forced
anchors.problem: Base-to-air thermal resistance and pressure drop of a plate-fin heat sink in ducted forced convection
anchors.replaces: A conjugate-heat-transfer solve per fin geometry during heat-sink sizing

members.task: Plate-fin heat sink in ducted forced convection: base-to-air thermal resistance and pressure drop

validity_range.fin_gap_note: gap sampled in 0.8-10 mm, then the fin count is rounded; the realised gaps of the training designs span 0.56-12.2 mm
validity_range.regime: ducted (no bypass) laminar/developing forced convection in air

limitations: Ducted flow: real heat sinks with bypass lose 20-50 % of the airflow; correct the velocity first.
Convection correlations carry a typical +-15 % accuracy; the surrogate's own error (<1 % mean) is against the engine, not against a measurement.
Screening tool: re-verify a chosen design with the physics engine.
members.citation: PINNeAPPle contributors (2026). HeatSink Sizer forced-convection surrogate. PINNeAPPle model zoo, https://github.com/PINNeAPPle-Labs/PINNeAPPle

anchors.name: Anchor-Thermal-Natural
anchors.problem: Base-to-air thermal resistance of a plate-fin heat sink in natural convection
anchors.replaces: A buoyancy-driven CFD solve per fin geometry where no fan is available

members.task: Plate-fin heat sink in natural convection (vertical fins, free air): base-to-air thermal resistance

validity_range.fin_gap_note: gap sampled in 2.5-20 mm, then the fin count is rounded; the realised gaps of the training designs span 2.2-30.6 mm
validity_range.regime: natural convection in free air, vertical fins, no radiation

limitations: Natural convection without radiation: at low power, radiation can carry a comparable share of the heat for black-anodised sinks; the reference does not model it.
Correlation-based reference (typical +-15 % against experiments); the surrogate's own error is against the engine, not against a measurement.
The engine's resistance rises with power on 0.5 % of designs (non-monotone correlation blending); the power law is checked on the model but not enforced in training.
Screening tool: re-verify a chosen design with the physics engine.
members.citation: PINNeAPPle contributors (2026). HeatSink Sizer natural-convection surrogate (monotone). PINNeAPPle model zoo, https://github.com/PINNeAPPle-Labs/PINNeAPPle
